entries.tactical_failure_mode_quoted: Papers attempting this tactic fail when the corruption-structure prior is asserted but never isolated as the actual source of gains. The recurring shape takes three forms: the "structure" is really a generic architecture or a powerful pretrained backbone doing the work, so same-capacity ablations cannot attribute any improvement to the prior; or the structural reformulation is theoretically clean — an equivalence proof, a physical decomposition — but the empirical delta over the base method is marginal while the advertised generality (plug-in, universal, attack-agnostic) is demonstrated on a single backbone or dataset; or the physical/derivational grounding is presented without rigor and with missing baselines, missing citations, or undersized evaluation.
